.writing-paper .draft-title{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #e7e8db;padding:8px 0 14px;font-size:25px;line-height:1.5;min-height:56px}.writing-paper input::placeholder{color:#a2a78f}.writing-paper textarea::placeholder{color:#929c82;font-size:17px;line-height:2.1}.writing-paper .draft-body{background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,transparent calc(2.05em - 1px),#e3e7d957 calc(2.05em - 1px),#e3e7d957 2.05em);background-position:0 17px;min-height:230px;height:30svh;padding:18px 55px 15px 0!important;font-size:18px;line-height:2.05;border:0;resize:vertical}.writing-paper .voice-field:has(#draft-body)>.voice-button{margin-top:16px}.writing-paper .voice-button{background:#edf1e68c;color:#718163}.writing-paper .draft-title:focus-visible,.writing-paper .draft-body:focus-visible{outline:none}.writing-tools{padding:15px 0 17px}.writing-tools .text-button{font-size:10px}.writing-tools>[data-writing-count]{font-size:9px;color:#8d967e;white-space:nowrap}.writing-footer{padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #e4e6d8}.writing-footer p{font-size:9px;color:#8a937d}.writing-footer .primary-button{font-size:12px;padding:10px 16px;background:#526b48;color:#fffef4;min-height:44px}.writing-focus .writing-layout{display:block;max-width:770px;margin:auto}.writing-focus .writing-paper{background:#fffef8}.writing-focus .paper-invitation,.writing-focus .writing-starts{display:none}
/* A shared, accessible voice stage above regular input dialogs. */
.voice-dialog{width:100%;max-width:none;height:100dvh;max-height:none;margin:0;border:0;border-radius:0;padding:25px 40px;color:#345347;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 44%,#f3f7eefa, #f7f6eef5 57%,#eeeeddF5);box-shadow:none;overflow:auto}

.voice-stage-state{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:24px;font-size:12px;color:#677f5f;letter-spacing:.12em}.voice-indicator{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#a0b294}.voice-dialog[data-state=listening] .voice-indicator{background:#688e65;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #7d9a7215}.voice-dialog[data-state=error] .voice-indicator{background:#b09669}.voice-dialog[data-state=error] .voice-orb{filter:saturate(.4);animation-play-state:paused;opacity:.75}
